entries.description: Related AI-agent skill for building, auditing, and repairing WCAG 2.2 web content with automated tooling and manual accessibility checks. Automated results alone do not prove conformance.

name: UUStreak
description: A web application that tracks WCAG compliance for Norwegian websites and provides a streak score for days without accessibility violations.
